Focus.relativeDescription: In this round, you kept choosing the route that stayed with the mission and returned after distractions.
Focus.packContribution: You bring steadiness and follow-through to the pack.

Vision.relativeDescription: In this round, you kept choosing the route that saw the arrangement, system and destination.
Vision.packContribution: You help the pack see where it is going.

Zoom.relativeDescription: In this round, small changes, exact features and unusual details caught your attention first.
Zoom.packContribution: You notice the clues the rest of the pack walks past.
Zoom.interpretation: Finds the clue everyone else missed.

Ideas.relativeDescription: In this round, you kept choosing unusual connections, new possibilities and alternative solutions.
Ideas.packContribution: You give the pack possibilities it had not considered.
Ideas.interpretation: Creates a route nobody else considered.

Energy.relativeDescription: In this round, you kept choosing movement, quick responses and the route that started now.
Energy.packContribution: You get the pack off the sofa and into the adventure.

questions.copy: You are a dog. A small sound happens somewhere in the house. What grabs you first?

A.copy: The sound itself, even if nobody else reacts

B.copy: The way the whole room responds

questions.copy: You are a dog, arriving at a very busy park. What does your attention land on first?

A.copy: The whole park and everything going on

B.copy: All the little details, toys and pawprints

questions.copy: You are a dog. You are busy with a bone in the kitchen when a letter drops through the door. What happens?

A.copy: I go straight back to my bone

B.copy: The new arrival sends me onto a different mission

questions.copy: You are a dog. You are in the garden. How do you dig?

B.copy: Lots of little holes all over the place

questions.copy: You are a dog. Somebody has slightly moved your dog bowl. What do you notice?

A.copy: The tiny change jumps out at me

B.copy: I start wondering who moved it and why

questions.copy: You are a dog. How would you remember a brand-new dog walk?

A.copy: As the shape of the whole route

B.copy: By each sign, tree and little landmark

questions.copy: You are a human now, building a den. Before you start, what is in your head?

A.copy: A clear picture of the finished den

B.copy: Lots of unusual things the den could become

questions.copy: You are a dog. On the walk there is a trail of pawprints in muddy ground, and one print is strange and different from the rest. What happens?

A.copy: My eyes go straight to the odd one

B.copy: I want to know what made the strange print

questions.copy: You are a dog. On the walk, the route is closed for maintenance. What is your first reaction?

A.copy: I work out a new plan before moving

B.copy: Excellent, we are going somewhere new

questions.copy: You are a human again now. You are halfway through a task when something else catches your interest. What do you do?

A.copy: Finish the job I have already started

B.copy: Follow the exciting thing and see where it leads

questions.copy: You are a dog again now. A family member in the home starts to say 'walkies'. When do you move?

A.copy: I am ready before the word is finished

B.copy: I wait to hear the whole plan before moving

questions.copy: You are a dog. You know you are about to get a treat. What are you like?

A.copy: Still and completely locked onto the mission

B.copy: Full of movement and ready to spring

questions.copy: You are a human now, halfway through a book when a squirrel of a thought runs off with you. What happens next?

A.copy: I find my way back to the exact point

B.copy: The squirrel leads me into a better new story

questions.copy: You are a dog, something lands upside down on the floor and you know it is not food. How do you work out its proper shape?

A.copy: I turn it around in my head

B.copy: I pick it up and test how the pieces fit

questions.copy: You are a dog. A strange automatic ball-thrower appears in the garden. What interests you first?

A.copy: Working out how the machine works

B.copy: Watching every little thing it does

SINGLE_CLOSE.summary: Your answers leaned most towards [MAIN], with [SUPPORTING] close behind.

SINGLE_CLEAR.summary: Your answers leaned most towards [MAIN], with [SUPPORTING] next.

TIE_TWO.summary: Your answers split between [POWER_1] and [POWER_2], with [SUPPORTING] next.

TIE_THREE.summary: Three powers came out level, so no single one leads. That is exactly what makes you the one every hero wants beside them.

TIE_FOUR.summary: Four powers came out level. You are not out in the field. You are the reason the field works.

TIE_FIVE.summary: All five powers came out perfectly level. This is the rarest result in the whole game.
